description: Create a new note in the shared cross-surface state store, or update an existing one if `id` is given. Returns the resulting note without its body (state_read id=N has it). When the note records a decision or setting, also pass `facts`: other agents then read the exact value, and a disagreement is caught.

confidence.description: Optional CLAIM, 0 to 1, of how sure you are of this note (0 = a guess, 1 = certain). It is only your claim: the server stores it next to your name, shows it to readers as a claim, and never uses it to rank notes or to override who is trusted. On update, null removes it.

facts.description: Settings as key/value pairs, e.g. {"package_manager":"pnpm","test_runner":"vitest"}. Use a common key when one fits: deploy_target, package_manager, test_runner, database, node_version, base_url, ci_provider, formatter. Add a subject prefix only when the project has several (api.deploy_target). At most 10; keys are lowercase a-z 0-9 _ . - (max 40 chars), values one line of at most 80 chars. The reply may carry `conflicts` (another writer states a different value; your write still succeeds, so tell the user) or `similar_keys` and a `hint` (an existing key looks like the same setting; follow the hint).

forget_after.description: Retention: days until this note is archived (soft-deleted, restorable). On update, resets the deadline; 0 clears it. Omit to keep the current deadline (none for new notes).

id.description: Id of an existing note to update. Omit to create a new note.

if_rev.description: Compare-and-swap: only update if the note is still at this revision (from a prior read). Omit to force.

namespace.description: Namespace/bucket for the note. Defaults to 'default'.

sensitivity.description: Who may read this note: public, internal (default) or private. A connection with a ceiling cannot read, write or relabel above it; lowering a label needs an admin.

source.description: Optional: who or what you CLAIM this note came from (not checked). The server records who really wrote it separately.

tags.description: Tags for the note (a list, or one comma-separated string).

title.description: Note title. When creating a note without one, it is made from the body's first line (about 60 characters) and the reply says so.

name: state_write
title: Write shared state
